chars.NARRATOR: a 38-year-old Moroccan man with short black hair and a trimmed black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a 33-year-old Moroccan woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a bright red long knit cardigan over a plain white dress
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a handsome 27-year-old Moroccan man with a styled black quiff, wearing a teal bomber jacket over a white t-shirt
chars.FATHER: a 60-year-old Moroccan man with grey hair and a grey moustache, wearing a beige djellaba
chars.MOTHER: a 58-year-old Moroccan woman wearing a dark green djellaba and a cream headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan apartment bedroom, WIFE (visibly pregnant) angrily stuffs clothes into an open suitcase on the bed while NARRATOR stands in the doorway with arms crossed, cold serious face. Both faces clearly visible in the middle of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the front door of a Moroccan apartment, WIFE walks out pulling a suitcase and holding a newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket, looking back over her shoulder with a sulky face; NARRATOR holds the door open, expressionless.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR flops happily onto the sofa of his now quiet Moroccan living room, arms spread wide, big relieved smile, eyes closed, sunlight through the window, mint tea glass on the low table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Comic shock: NARRATOR on his own apartment balcony freezes with his mouth wide open, holding a watering can that spills; on the very next balcony of the neighbouring flat, WIFE stands smiling arm in arm with NEIGHBOUR, both looking at NARRATOR. Moroccan residential building with white walls and green shutters.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR peeks through his half-open apartment door into the shared stairwell, annoyed and jealous expression, watching WIFE and NEIGHBOUR laughing together as they carry grocery bags up the stairs. Faces visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Split composition: on the left NARRATOR in his living room holds a phone to his ear, surprised; on the right FATHER in a traditional Moroccan salon with patterned cushions holds a phone, head bowed, ashamed and apologetic. Both faces visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: FATHER and MOTHER sit together on a traditional Moroccan sedari sofa, both shaking their heads in disappointment, MOTHER wiping a tear with her scarf, FATHER with his hand raised as if saying 'she is no daughter of ours'.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR and FATHER shake hands warmly at the entrance of a Moroccan house, FATHER looks humble and grateful, NARRATOR gives a calm respectful smile.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits at a Moroccan cafe terrace table with a glass of mint tea, leaning forward and looking straight at the viewer with a thoughtful questioning face, one hand open as if asking a question. Medium shot, face in the middle.
